articles.title: Gwen Stefani and Blake Shelton’s 18-year-old dog Betty passes away

articles.title: Igho Ubiribo passes away at 43
articles.summary: At the age of forty-three, British-Nigerian entrepreneur Igho Ubiribo's life was cut short in Thailand due to complications following a cosmetic penile enlargement operation. The coroner's report attributes his death to a pulmonary embolism.
